result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.max_flow_value()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute only the maximum flow value from source to sink. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L21346-L21398){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.max_flow_value( source, sink, capacity=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} This is a faster variant of `max_flow()` when you only need the flow value and not the flow assignment on each edge. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Source node (integer ID or string label). [sink]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Sink node (integer ID or string label). [capacity]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional name of edge attribute to use as capacity. If `None` (the default), uses edge weights for weighted graphs, or `1.0` for unweighted graphs. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The maximum flow value. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} The path from `S` to `T` passes through `A`, so the bottleneck is the smaller of the two edge weights along the way: ::: {#91e6d134 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True, weighted=True) .add_node(label="S") .add_node(label="T") .add_node(label="A") .add_edge("S", "A", weight=10.0) .add_edge("A", "T", weight=5.0) ) # Returns 5.0 (limited by the S -> A -> T bottleneck) graph.max_flow_value("S", "T") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 5.0 ``` ::: :::
